import hashlib
import json
import logging
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import traceback
import uuid
from time import monotonic

from complete_main_onboarding_native import observation

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'tests/integration'))
import hidden_desktop

source = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
output = Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
if not hidden_desktop.is_child(output):
    assert not (output / 'result.json').exists(), 'Use a fresh output directory'
    hidden_desktop.DESKTOP = f'FrontEngineColdReload{os.getpid()}_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}'
    before = observation()
    code = hidden_desktop.run_on_hidden_desktop(__file__, str(source), str(output), timeout_ms=180000)
    (output / 'observer.json').write_text(json.dumps({'before': before, 'after': observation(),
        'child_exit': code, 'observation_only': True}, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    raise SystemExit(code)

os.environ['QT_QPA_PLATFORM'] = 'windows'
case = source.name
result = {'passed': False}
try:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='fe-current-cold-reload-') as folder:
        previous = Path.cwd()
        os.chdir(folder)
        try:
            from PySide6.QtCore import QCoreApplication, QEvent
            from PySide6.QtTest import QTest
            from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
            from frontengine.ui.page.pet_game import home_page
            from frontengine.utils.session_lock import session_lock
            from frontengine.user_setting.user_setting_file import user_setting_dict
            from frontengine.utils.pet_game import snapshot

            home_page.workshop_pack_roots = lambda: []
            session_lock.is_session_locked = lambda: False
            app = QApplication([])
            app.setQuitOnLastWindowClosed(False)
            from frontengine.ui import main_ui
            main_ui.CriticalExit.init_critical_exit = lambda self: None
            main_ui.HotkeyService.start = lambda self: False
            main_ui.AppProfileService.start = lambda self: None
            main_ui.ShareWatchService.start = lambda self: None
            window = main_ui.FrontEngineMainUI(show_system_tray_ray=False, redirect_output=False)
            lifetime = window.lifetime
            page = window.pet_home_ui
            try:
                from frontengine.utils.pet_game import behaviour, simulation
                from frontengine.show.pet_game.captions import result_text
                service = page.service
                from PySide6.QtGui import QGuiApplication
                screen = QGuiApplication.primaryScreen()
                area = screen.availableGeometry()
                world = service.create_home((screen.name() or 'primary')[:128], area.x(), area.bottom(), 48, seed=5)
                world.time_ms = 0
                world.automatic = False
                zone = next(iter(world.zones))
                world.ledger.apply('fixture', 'native acceptance setup', 500)
                pet = service.profiles.create('Mochi')['id']
                service.profiles.update(pet, {'mood': 80, 'fullness': 90, 'energy': 95})
                assert service.adopt(pet, zone) == 'accepted'
                resident = world.residents[pet]
                recipe = 'toy' if case == 'waiting_materials' else 'letter'
                if case == 'waiting_materials':
                    assert world.buy_and_place('workbench', zone, 'bench') == 'accepted'
                elif case == 'station_busy':
                    world.furnish(zone)
                    other = service.profiles.create('Desk user')['id']
                    service.profiles.update(other, {'mood': 80, 'fullness': 90, 'energy': 95})
                    assert service.adopt(other, zone) == 'accepted'
                    assert world.create_task('letter', other)[0] == 'accepted'
                    assert behaviour.start_work(world, world.residents[other], 'command') is None
                    assert world.residents[other].activity.kind == 'work'
                else:
                    assert case == 'no_station'
                assert world.create_task(recipe, pet)[0] == 'accepted'
                world.drain_events()
                assert world.command(pet, 'work') == 'accepted'
                simulation.step(world)
                command_events = world.drain_events()
                assert resident.activity.kind != 'work'
                assert [e['reason'] for e in command_events if e['kind'] == 'refused'] == [case]
                result['refusal_events'] = command_events
                window.resize(1280, 960)
                window.show()
                page.refresh()
                page.tabs.setCurrentIndex(page.tabs.keys().index('pet_home_residents_section'))
                page.select_resident(pet)
                QTest.qWait(1000)
                page._scroll.ensureWidgetVisible(page.residents.activity)
                QTest.qWait(200)
                caption = page.residents.activity.text()
                assert result_text(case) in caption, caption
                assert not page.residents.activity.visibleRegion().isEmpty()
                assert window.grab().save(str(output / 'blocked.png'))
                if case == 'waiting_materials':
                    world.ledger.apply('wood', 'native acceptance setup', items={'wood': 2})
                elif case == 'no_station':
                    world.furnish(zone)
                else:
                    behaviour.cancel_activity(world, world.residents[other], 'fixture')
                behaviour.cancel_activity(world, resident, 'fixture')
                world.drain_events()
                assert world.command(pet, 'work') == 'accepted'
                simulation.step(world)
                command_events = world.drain_events()
                page.refresh()
                assert resident.activity.kind == 'work'
                recovered = page.residents.activity.text()
                assert result_text(case) not in recovered
                page._scroll.ensureWidgetVisible(page.residents.activity)
                QTest.qWait(200)
                assert window.grab().save(str(output / 'recovered.png'))
                assert not [e for e in command_events if e['kind'] == 'refused']
                result.update(case=case, blocked_caption=caption, recovered_caption=recovered,
                              recovered_activity=resident.activity.kind)
            finally:
                window.request_shutdown()
                deadline = monotonic() + 120
                while not lifetime.closed and monotonic() < deadline:
                    QCoreApplication.sendPostedEvents(None, QEvent.Type.DeferredDelete)
                    app.processEvents()
                    QTest.qWait(10)
                assert lifetime.closed, (lifetime.state, lifetime.error)
            result.update(passed=True, runtime_closed=True, python=sys.version,
                source=str(source),
                scope='Native MainUI on private desktop; deterministic fixture and two manual work commands followed by explicit normal simulation steps, service timer stopped, validates visible captions and recovery only; global service starts, Workshop and lock query substituted')
        finally:
            logging.shutdown()
            os.chdir(previous)
    result['temporary_directory_removed'] = True
except Exception:
    result.update(passed=False, error=traceback.format_exc())
(output / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
raise SystemExit(0 if result['passed'] else 1)
